id: 01_Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safety O
title: 安全日知识竞赛：二十道综合安全题
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/01_Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safety O.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/01_Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safety O/src.py

points.K1: 测验规则：先做再对答案
points.K6: 职业健康安全管理体系
points.K20: 空调不含消耗臭氧层物质

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，台上有抢答铃，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium with a buzzer on it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全日到了，我们来办知识竞赛！
overlay: 安全日知识竞赛：二十道综合安全题

shots.scene: 一排图标：汽车、警铃、心形、火焰、电插头、垃圾桶、化学品瓶
shots.prompt_en: A row of simple icons: a car, an alarm bell, a heart, a flame, a power plug, a waste bin and a chemical bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 交通、疏散、急救、消防、环保，样样都有。

shots.scene: 阿杰在单位大厅看到安全日竞赛海报，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a blank quiz competition poster in a building lobby and scratches his head.
shots.narration: 安全日到了，阿杰想先练练手。

shots.scene: 小研递给他一张空白答题卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a blank answer card with a smile.
shots.narration: 小研说：先自己答，再对答案。

shots.scene: 王老师抱着一叠空白答题卡走来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks in carrying a stack of blank answer cards.
shots.narration: 王老师来当裁判，测验开始。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：先做再对答案
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张空白答题卡，旁边浮现题数与分值图示
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank answer card; beside it float simple number blocks and a progress bar. No text.
shots.narration: 一共二十题，每题五分，满分一百。
overlay: 测验规则：先做再对答案

shots.section_title: 测验规则：先做再对答案
shots.scene: 一个进度条在八成处画一面小旗
shots.prompt_en: A long progress bar with a small flag planted at four fifths of its length. No people.
shots.narration: 答对八成，就算及格。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：先做再对答案
shots.scene: 阿杰捂住答案页，自己在答题卡上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student covers an answer sheet with one hand and ticks boxes on a blank answer card with the other.
shots.narration: 先别看答案，自己做一遍。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：先做再对答案
shots.scene: 阿杰对照答案，数着打勾的数量
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares his card with an answer sheet and counts the ticks with his finger.
shots.narration: 做完再核对，看自己答对了几题。

shots.scene: 四张桌子，各坐一队，桌上立着A、B、C、D小旗图标
shots.prompt_en: Four tables in a hall, each with a small team of students and a small colored flag on it. No text.
shots.narration: 把大家分成四队，各占一张桌。

shots.scene: 一个纸箱里放着折好的纸签，阿杰伸手抽签
shots.prompt_en: The young male student draws a folded paper slip from a small box full of folded blank slips.
shots.narration: 每队轮流抽签，签上是题号。

shots.scene: 王老师在白板上给队伍加分
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator adds marks next to team flags on a blank whiteboard with a marker.
shots.narration: 答对加五分，答错不得分。

shots.scene: 白板上四根柱子高低不同，一队胜出举杯
shots.prompt_en: A blank whiteboard with four bars of different heights; one team raises a small trophy happily.
shots.narration: 最后比总分，得分最高的队获胜。

shots.scene: 汽车排气管冒出灰色烟雾，旁边四个气体分子图标
shots.prompt_en: A car exhaust pipe releasing gray fumes, with four different simple gas molecule icons floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：车辆排出的哪种气体伤健康？

shots.scene: 四个选项气泡
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles with simple gas molecule icons. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳、一氧化碳、氯氟烃、氢氟烃。

shots.scene: 一个分子图标亮起，配骷髅警示图标
shots.prompt_en: One molecule icon glows brightly next to a skull warning pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，一氧化碳。

shots.scene: 汽车驾驶座视角，四个小图标：杯子、说话气泡、眼睛看路、收音机
shots.prompt_en: A car driver's seat view with four small icons: a drink cup, a speech bubble, an eye looking at the road and a radio dial. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：以下都是驾驶分心，除了哪项？

shots.scene: 杯子、说话气泡、收音机三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The drink cup, speech bubble and radio icons are each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 吃喝、聊天、调收音机都是分心。

shots.scene: 眼睛看路的图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The eye-on-the-road icon gets a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，注视前方道路。

shots.scene: 走廊里警铃闪烁，几个人回头张望
shots.prompt_en: An alarm bell flashing in a corridor; a few office workers turn their heads in surprise.
shots.narration: 第三题：疏散演练时，该怎么做？

shots.scene: 关电脑、去叫同事、坐等广播三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a computer being shut down, a person calling a colleague and a waiting loudspeaker. No people.
shots.narration: 先关电脑？先叫同事？等广播？

shots.scene: 人们沿着绿色箭头快步走向安全出口
shots.prompt_en: Office workers walk briskly along green arrows toward an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 答案C，听到警报立即疏散。

shots.section_title: 职业健康安全管理体系
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一本封面只有安全帽和心形图标的书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank book whose cover shows only a hard hat icon and a heart icon.
shots.narration: 第四题：这套体系管哪类健康安全？
overlay: 职业健康安全管理体系

shots.section_title: 职业健康安全管理体系
shots.scene: 四个选项气泡，其中“职业健康安全”亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles; one bubble with a worker and heart icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，职业健康与安全。

shots.section_title: 职业健康安全管理体系
shots.scene: 欣欣指向书架上另一本空白的书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to another blank book on a shelf.
shots.narration: 主讲人补充：现在用的是ISO 45001。

shots.scene: 地球图标和齿轮图标组合
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon combined with a gear icon and a leaf. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：EMS的全称是什么？

shots.scene: 四个选项气泡，“环境管理体系”亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles; the one with a globe and leaf icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，环境管理体系。

shots.scene: 马路上一个敞开的检修井口，没有盖板和围挡
shots.prompt_en: An open manhole on a road with no cover and no barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：没防护的人孔，是哪类例子？

shots.scene: 四个卡片：事件、未遂事件、不安全状态、不安全行为
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards in a row with icons: a bang, a near-fall, a hazard triangle on an object and a person icon doing something wrong. No people.
shots.narration: 事件、未遂、不安全状态、不安全行为。

shots.scene: “物”的卡片亮起，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The card with a hazard triangle on an object glows with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，不安全状态。

shots.scene: 心形图标和肺部图标
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon next to a pair of lungs icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：CPR是什么意思？

shots.scene: 四个选项气泡，“心肺复苏”亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles; the one with a heart and lungs icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，心肺复苏。

shots.scene: 四个图标：核电站冷却塔、烟囱电厂、风车、闪电
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a nuclear cooling tower, a coal power plant chimney, a wind turbine and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：哪种发电方式对环境好？

shots.scene: 风车图标亮起，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The wind turbine icon glows with a green check mark; green hills around it. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，风能发电。

shots.scene: 红色三角形，三条边上分别是火焰、木块、空气图标
shots.prompt_en: A red triangle with icons on its three sides: a flame, a block of wood and an air swirl. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：火三角由什么组成？

shots.scene: 三角形三边亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three sides of the triangle light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，热、可燃物、氧气。

shots.scene: 司机打哈欠，眼皮下垂，车灯在夜里
shots.prompt_en: A tired driver yawns at night with drooping eyelids, headlights shining on a dark road.
shots.narration: 第十题：司机渐失警觉、打盹、睡着。

shots.scene: 四个选项气泡：头痛、疲劳、醉酒、窒息
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles with icons: a head with pain lines, a low battery, a bottle and a choking throat. No people.
shots.narration: 头痛、疲劳、醉酒，还是窒息？

shots.scene: 电量低的电池图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The low battery icon lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，这叫疲劳。

shots.scene: 一杯清水，旁边四个选项气泡
shots.prompt_en: A clear glass of water with four blank option bubbles around it. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：可直接饮用的水叫什么？

shots.scene: 水杯配绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The glass of water with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，potable，饮用水。

shots.scene: 一个人躺在地上，脸色苍白，旁边心脏和氧气图标变暗
shots.prompt_en: A pale person lying on the floor; a heart icon and an oxygen icon beside him fade.
shots.narration: 第十二题：休克时身体发生什么？

shots.scene: 氧气图标向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen molecule icon with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，体内供氧减少。

shots.scene: 地球图标，周围温度计、臭氧层破洞、绿叶循环图标
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon surrounded by a rising thermometer, a hole in a protective layer and a green leaf cycle. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：全球环保有哪些议题？

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three icons receive green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，变暖、臭氧、可持续都是。

shots.scene: 一辆车停在检测线上，排气管接着检测仪
shots.prompt_en: A car on an inspection line with an emission testing probe attached to its exhaust pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 第十四题：按印度机动车法的这张证明。

shots.scene: 空白的检验合格单
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection certificate with a green check stamp next to a clean car. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，污染受控证明。

shots.scene: 微波炉图标，内部有波纹线
shots.prompt_en: A microwave oven icon with wavy lines inside. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五题：微波炉产生什么？

shots.scene: 波纹线亮起，配电磁波图标
shots.prompt_en: The wavy lines glow, with an electromagnetic wave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，电磁波。

shots.scene: 电器外壳带电的闪电图标，一只手触碰
shots.prompt_en: An appliance casing with a lightning icon and a hand reaching to touch it. No people.
shots.narration: 第十六题：电器没做什么，会触电？

shots.scene: 接地符号亮起
shots.prompt_en: An electrical grounding symbol lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，没有接地。

shots.scene: 三个循环箭头，分别是减量、再利用、再循环图标
shots.prompt_en: Three curved arrows forming a cycle, each with an icon: a shrinking box, a refilled bottle and a recycling symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第十七题：废物管理是什么？

shots.scene: 三个箭头依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three arrows light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，减量、再利用、再循环。

shots.section_title: 空调不含消耗臭氧层物质
shots.scene: 空调外机图标，旁边四个部件图标
shots.prompt_en: An air conditioner outdoor unit icon with four component icons around it: a filter, a compressor, a gas cloud and a coil. No people.
shots.narration: 第十八题：空调里不应含有什么？
overlay: 空调不含消耗臭氧层物质

shots.section_title: 空调不含消耗臭氧层物质
shots.scene: 气体云图标亮起并打叉，臭氧层破洞图标
shots.prompt_en: The gas cloud icon is crossed out with a red X next to an icon of a hole in the ozone layer. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，消耗臭氧层物质。

shots.scene: 医院图标，四个选项：病理实验室、X光机、焚烧炉、血库
shots.prompt_en: A hospital icon with four option icons: a microscope, an X-ray machine, an incinerator and a blood bag. No people.
shots.narration: 第十九题：医院用什么处置医疗废物？

shots.scene: 焚烧炉图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The incinerator icon glows. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，焚烧炉。

shots.scene: 一份空白的多页文件，封面有化学瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank multi-page document with a chemical bottle icon on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十题：MSDS的全称是什么？

shots.scene: 选项气泡中“安全数据表”亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles; the one with a document and shield icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，物质安全数据表。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前，白板上一张答案表格
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with a blank answer grid of twenty boxes.
shots.narration: 来看答案表，先做完再核对。

shots.scene: 答案表格下半部分亮起
shots.prompt_en: The lower half of the blank answer grid lights up box by box. No people.
shots.narration: 十一到二十题，答案在这里。

shots.scene: 阿杰对照答案表，数着打勾的数量
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares his answer card with the grid and counts the ticks with his finger.
shots.narration: 数数答对几题，八成就及格。

shots.scene: 四队围桌，王老师在白板记分
shots.prompt_en: Four team tables in a hall; the safety administrator records scores on a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 也可以拿去办安全日竞赛。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起奖杯，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small trophy and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 先做再对答案，下次测验见！
